name: The Cosmological Axis of Yogyakarta and its Historic Landmarks
description: In the Javanese royal city of Yogyakarta, a straight six-kilometre line runs from the Kraton palace at its centre toward Mount Merapi in the north and the Indian Ocean in the south. Sultan Mangkubumi laid it out in the 18th century, and monuments along it are still tied together by ritual. Walking it, you move through a living map of Javanese beliefs about the cosmos and the stages of life.
